Prelaunch.metaDescription: OPTA connects people's potential with opportunities to transform their territories. Leave us your email and we'll let you know when we open.
Prelaunch.title: The talent in communities can transform their territories.
Prelaunch.lead: OPTA connects people's potential with opportunities to transform their territories. We're building the route and want to tell you when it opens.

grow.name: Grow
grow.text: Emotional well-being and recognition of the abilities each person already has.

create.name: Create
create.text: Training in entrepreneurship, finance, technology and marketing.

connect.name: Connect
connect.text: Links to jobs, markets, funding and allies.

consent.label: I authorize Fundación Embajadores de la Paz, responsible for OPTA, to process my data to send me news and let me know when we open. I can withdraw my authorization at any time. Read the <privacy>data protection policy</privacy>.
consent.error: We need your authorization to sign you up.

sent.title: Almost there, {name}.
sent.text: We sent you an email to confirm your signup. If you don't see it in a few minutes, check your spam folder.

Waitlist.unavailable: We couldn't send your signup. Your details are still here: try again in a few minutes.

Privacy.title: Data protection policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data the OPTA waitlist collects, what we use it for and how you can exercise your rights.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.text: Fundación Embajadores de la Paz, responsible for OPTA, NIT 901679710-4, based at Carrera 13 #2N-49, Torre Fundadores 202, Armenia, Quindío. Legal representative: Stephania Forero. Phone: +57 310 587 4657.

data.title: What data we ask for
data.text: Your name and your email address.

purpose.title: What we use it for
purpose.text: To send you news from OPTA and let you know when we open. We don't use it for anything else.

processor.title: Who helps us send the emails
processor.text: We send newsletters with Zoho Campaigns and confirmation emails with Zoho CPaaS, both from Zoho Corporation. The site is hosted on Netlify. These providers may store data on servers outside Colombia.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can access, update and correct your data, ask us to delete it and withdraw your authorization at any time. You can also use the unsubscribe link in every email.

Privacy.contactEn: If you prefer to write in English:

Confirmed.title: Done, you're on the list
Confirmed.lead: We'll write to you when there's news.
Confirmed.frequency: Few emails: when we open and how to take part.

Unsubscribed.title: Done, we won't write to you again
Unsubscribed.lead: We removed your email from the list. If this was a mistake, you can sign up again from the home page.

Confirm.title: Confirm your signup
Confirm.lead: Tap the button to confirm that you want to receive OPTA news at this email address.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.text: Confirmation links last 7 days. Sign up again and we'll send you a new one.

invalid.title: We don't recognize this link
invalid.text: It may be incomplete. Copy the full link from the email or sign up again.

blocked.text: This email address asked not to receive messages from OPTA. If you want to come back, write to us at privacy@rutaopta.org.

unavailable.text: We couldn't confirm your signup. Try again in a few minutes.

ConfirmEmail.subject: Confirm your signup to OPTA
ConfirmEmail.preheader: One click and you're on the list.
ConfirmEmail.heading: Confirm your signup
ConfirmEmail.p1: Someone, hopefully you, asked to receive OPTA news at this email address.
ConfirmEmail.p2: If it was you, confirm with the button. The link lasts 7 days.
ConfirmEmail.p3: If it wasn't you, ignore this message: we won't write to you.
